byte_budget.notes: Thresholds tightened after supply-chain tier classification and struct packing (issue #871).

variants.name: GlobalMaxLogs
variants.comment: Replaced by Config — kept as tombstone variant so existing encoded keys don't collide; no longer written.

variants.name: Paused
variants.comment: Paused flag: when true, write operations are blocked.

variants.name: SubmitterBlocklist
variants.comment: Blocked submitters cannot submit events (issue #141).

variants.name: AllowlistMode
variants.comment: If true, allowlist mode is enabled (issue #141).

variants.name: SubmitterAllowlist
variants.comment: Per-submitter allowlist state (issue #141).

variants.name: TotalEvents
variants.comment: Replaced by Config — kept as tombstone variant.

variants.name: EventCapSet
variants.comment: Replaced by EventCapConfig(Symbol) — kept as tombstone variant.

variants.name: EventMaxLogs
variants.comment: Replaced by EventCapConfig(Symbol) — kept as tombstone variant.

variants.name: EventTypeIndices
variants.comment: Stores packed Bytes of u32 global-order indices (4 bytes each, LE) for a type (issue #54).

variants.name: SubmitterEventIndices
variants.comment: Stores packed Bytes of u32 global-order indices (4 bytes each, LE) for a submitter (issue #206).

variants.name: SubmitterEventCount
variants.comment: Cached event count per submitter (issue #206).

variants.name: EventData
variants.comment: Primary storage: event ID → Event.

variants.name: EventOrder
variants.comment: Sequential index → event ID, for ordered retrieval.

variants.name: EventMetadataMaxSize
variants.comment: Per-event-type metadata size cap (issue #67). Absent = use global default.

variants.name: GlobalMetadataMaxSize
variants.comment: Global metadata size cap (issue #67). Absent = DEFAULT_MAX_METADATA_SIZE.

variants.name: MetadataSchema
variants.comment: Per-event-type metadata validation schema (issue #202). Absent = no schema constraint.

variants.name: EventSchema
variants.comment: Versioned schema registry entry for a specific event type and schema version.

variants.name: SchemaVersions
variants.comment: Registered schema versions keyed by event type.

variants.name: EventSchemaMigration
variants.comment: Migration function for metadata updates between schema versions.

variants.name: RuntimeState
variants.comment: Cached full runtime state for fast reads.

variants.name: EventSignature
variants.comment: Signature stored for an event (issue #69): (pubkey, signature).

variants.name: EventTypeCount
variants.comment: Cached event count per type (issue #52). Updated alongside EventTypeIndices.

variants.name: EventHeaderKey
variants.comment: Lightweight header (issue #56): EventHeader stored separately from metadata.

variants.name: EventMeta
variants.comment: Optimized storage for event headers (issue #53): (index, timestamp, event_type, submitter).

variants.name: EventMetadata
variants.comment: Optimized storage for event metadata alone (issue #53).

variants.name: EventVersions
variants.comment: Stored update history for events indexed by event order.

variants.name: EventEmissionConfig
variants.comment: Event emission configuration (issue #60): 0=full, 1=index-only, 2=hash-only, 3=none.

variants.name: EventEmissionVersion
variants.comment: Event emission version (issue #60): 1=full metadata, 2=index-only.

variants.name: LowCostMode
variants.comment: Low-cost mode configuration (issue #57): 0=normal, 1=low-cost.

variants.name: SubmitterRateLimit
variants.comment: Rate limit (max events per ledger timestamp) for a submitter (issue #62). 0 = blocked.

variants.name: SubmitterRateState
variants.comment: Rate-limit state (last_timestamp, count) per submitter (issue #62).

variants.name: SubmitterNonce
variants.comment: Per-submitter nonce for replay-attack prevention (issue #64). Stores the last accepted nonce; absent means no event submitted yet (treat as 0).

variants.name: SubmitterNonceConfig
variants.comment: Packed nonce state per submitter (issue #214): window_size, max_nonce.

variants.name: DefaultNonceWindowSize
variants.comment: Global default nonce window size (issue #214).

variants.name: DefaultNonceMaxValue
variants.comment: Global maximum nonce value before exhaustion (issue #214).

variants.name: EventTtl
variants.comment: TTL configuration (#121): number of ledgers after which persistent events are eligible for expiry. Absent = TTL disabled (instance storage, no expiry).

variants.name: ContractVersion
variants.comment: Contract version marker.

variants.name: EventContentHash
variants.comment: Content-addressed dedup hash → event index.

variants.name: CategoryMaxLen
variants.comment: Max category symbol byte length.

variants.name: LogEventReentrancyGuard
variants.comment: Reentrancy guard marker (issue #61).

variants.name: PausedSince
variants.comment: Timestamp when the contract was paused (issue #78).

variants.name: PauseConfig
variants.comment: Granular pause configuration (issue #415).

variants.name: PauseReason
variants.comment: Reason string for pause (issue #415).

variants.name: PauseMetadata
variants.comment: Arbitrary metadata for pause (issue #415).

variants.name: PauseExpiration
variants.comment: Expiration timestamp for auto-unpause (issue #415).

variants.name: WebhookRegistrations
variants.comment: Webhook registrations (#25): per-event-type list of (url, secret) pairs. Owner-only.

variants.name: SnapshotCount
variants.comment: Snapshot count — total snapshots created (issue #213).

variants.name: SnapshotData
variants.comment: Individual snapshot data keyed by snapshot index (issue #213).

variants.name: TtlCleanupStats
variants.comment: Cumulative TTL cleanup statistics (issue #200).

variants.name: ArchiveScanCursor
variants.comment: Resume cursor for archive_events scans (issue #199).

variants.name: MaterialPassport
variants.comment: Material passport keyed by a 32-byte material ID.

variants.name: AllMaterialIds
variants.comment: All material IDs registered (packed 32-byte chunks).

variants.name: MaterialLoopEvents
variants.comment: Loop events for a material, stored as a Vec<LoopEvent>.

variants.name: CircularitySnapshot
variants.comment: Circularity snapshot keyed by ledger sequence (u32).

variants.name: CircularitySnapshotCount
variants.comment: Total number of circularity snapshots taken.

variants.name: CircularityTotals
variants.comment: Running totals for circularity metric aggregates.

variants.name: LcaProfile
variants.comment: LCA profile keyed by product ID (32-byte content-addressed).

variants.name: LcaPhaseImpact
variants.comment: Phase impacts stored per (product_id, phase_discriminant).

variants.name: LcaResult
variants.comment: Finalized LCA result (aggregated across all phases).

variants.name: LcaNormRef
variants.comment: Normalization reference values set keyed by a short name Symbol.

variants.name: LcaWeightingScheme
variants.comment: Weighting scheme keyed by a short name Symbol.

variants.name: LcaUncertainty
variants.comment: Uncertainty bounds (interval arithmetic) for a product's aggregated impacts.

variants.name: LcaDbEntry
variants.comment: LCA database entry keyed by a 32-byte reference ID.

variants.name: LcaProfileCount
variants.comment: Total number of LCA profiles registered.
